notes: wowsims-forever models one Hunter spell package for all three specs; this is the spec the fork's own p1.apl.json preset is already built for (heavy Aimed Shot weaving), so it is the closest adaptation of the three hunter files. Marksmanship also keeps Serpent Sting up for the extra sustained damage, unlike Beast Mastery where community guides call it not worth a global. Every rank named here is checked against this build's own spellconst: the preset names Multi-Shot as spell 25294, which does not exist in this build (Multi-Shot only has one rank here, 2643), and calls Serpent Sting rank 8 when 25295 is actually rank 9 -- both fixed here rather than copied stale. Aimed Shot (20904) is registered by the engine again since 2026-09-28 (its registration had been commented out, and the cast line was declared inert until then). What did need fixing: nothing in this site's request pipeline (sim/request) ever sets a character's DistanceFromTarget, so every hunter starts at 0 -- inside Raptor Strike's melee range but under Multi-Shot, Serpent Sting and Aimed Shot's own ExtraCastCondition floor of 12 (core.MinRangedAttackDistance), which also gates the ranged auto-attack itself (sim/core/attack.go's startPull). A `move` prepull action to 30 yards is added so this and every future simulation of this spec actually has a ranged auto-attack and can cast its ranged abilities, matching how a Marksmanship hunter is actually played. Under this smoke build specifically (no gear equipped anywhere) the ranged weapon's SwingSpeed is the Weapon{} zero value, which collapses the ranged swing timer to its 500ms cast-time floor (sim/core/attack.go's WeaponAttack.updateSwingDuration: curSwingDuration = weapon.SwingSpeed / hasteMultiplier = 0) -- a real ranged weapon's positive SwingSpeed does not have this problem. The resulting sub-GCD auto-shot loop saturates the character's action economy so completely that the priority list, including Multi-Shot and Serpent Sting, never gets a decision window in this one bare-weapon run; this is a new engine-side artifact of the no-gear smoke build (recorded for the engine ledger), not a defect in this rotation's gates. Rotation-accuracy program diagnosis (2026-09-28): the inert ids above (Multi-Shot 2643, Rapid Fire 3045) are level-gated in the engine (sim/hunter/multi_shot.go RequiredLevel 18, sim/hunter/rapid_fire.go's registerRapidFire returns if hunter.Level < 26) but carry rank:0 rows in spellranks.json, which the ladder's idLearnLevel deliberately does not level-gate (the same skip keeps Bloodrage/Judgement -- genuinely never level-gated by the engine -- from being wrongly treated as gated); not declared inert here (both resolve fine above their real gate under the pinned engine); see hunter-beast-mastery.json's notes (the shared hunter spell package all three specs use) for the full diagnosis and the sim/internal/spellranks + sim/request/ladder.go fix that actually resolves this. 2026-10-31 (theorycraft audit fixes): Multi-Shot and Aimed Shot share one 6 second cooldown in Forever (client spell category 2; both tooltips say so), and the engine now runs them on one timer. On that shared timer the instant Multi-Shot outdamages Aimed Shot, whose 2 second cast pauses the auto shot, so Multi-Shot fires on every cooldown and Aimed Shot is only the pre-pull opener. The lines that used to read Aimed Shot's cooldown now read Multi-Shot's, the same clock. Client 1.60.1.70707 (2026-10-31): Aspect of the Hawk's ranks 1-5 fell to 15/22/30/38/47 ranged attack power, so rank 6 (14322, 55) is the strongest from level 58 and the prepull casts it; through 70685 rank 5 (90) was, and rank 6 was skipped as inferior. 2026-11-03 (sim-accuracy round 13, server hotfix push for 1.60.1.70753): Aimed Shot about doubled at every rank, Arcane Shot, Serpent Sting, Aspect of the Hawk and Trueshot Aura went up. Aimed Shot now takes the shared cooldown whenever the next auto shot is more than 1.2 seconds away, and Multi-Shot only when the cast would hold an auto shot; measured beyond error at seeds 1 and 50001. Serpent Sting is back in the list (it was dropped by the 2026-10-08 rotation search): on this engine it gains beyond error at both seeds, before and after the push. 2026-11-04 (sim-accuracy round 20): Blizzard's 3 November notes put 15% of ranged attack power on Arcane Shot and 5% a tick on Serpent Sting, so Multi-Shot is now the worst shot for its mana. Multi-Shot waits while mana is under a quarter and Arcane Shot's own mana gate is gone; measured beyond error at seeds 1 and 50001 on 180 s and on 420 s fights. 2026-11-05 (sim-accuracy round 21): Hunter's Mark goes up 20 seconds before the pull, ahead of the aspect, so the mana it costs is back by the pull. The engine used to hold the mark to 0 as if it were a damaging shot (it carried a spell damage proc mask), where it failed under Aimed Shot's cast or spent the opening global; the fork now gives it no damage mask. 2026-11-05 (sim-accuracy round 21, G1 from guide-accuracy round 20): below 34 Serpent Sting and Arcane Shot no longer wait on Multi-Shot's cooldown while Multi-Shot is held under a quarter mana (gate: not spellIsKnown Explosive Trap 13813, trained at 34). Before this, at 18 and 19 the card cast nothing but Hunter's Mark below a quarter mana, and at 20-33 only Aimed Shot spent the cooldown. Bare: Beast Mastery +5.5% (20) to +1.6% (33), Marksmanship +4.0% (20) to +0.1% (33); 34 and above unchanged (the same branch everywhere lost 0.1-0.6% at 35-49 and 60, while 50-59 would gain 2-3.5%, which no level test can scope today). 2026-11-05 (sim-accuracy round 21, auto shot): in Forever an Auto Shot fires while Aimed Shot (and Sniper Shot) is being cast (beta logs, nine hunters: about 60% of Aimed Shot casts carry an Auto Shot inside the cast). The engine now keeps the auto timer running through the cast (fork, RangedShootsWhileCasting), so the old gate (cast only right after an auto shot fires) is gone: Aimed Shot and Sniper Shot go whenever the shared cooldown is up. 2026-11-05 (round 21, rendered-card review): the low-mana branch of the sting and Arcane Shot loses its below-34 scope. With Aimed Shot ungated the branch ties everywhere from 34 and fixes a real stall at 50-51, where the top Aimed Shot rank is out of reach under a quarter mana and the shared cooldown sat ready with nothing to spend it (Marksmanship 50: Arcane Shot 10.1 -> 19.8 casts).

priorityList.notes: Hunter's Mark whenever the target is not marked. One mark per target is enough: if another hunter's mark is already up, leave it.

Rapid Fire on the pull, as an auto shot leaves and the shared cooldown is about to come back. The haste starts on a fresh shot and the first Aimed Shot lands inside it. It is a five minute cooldown in the raid build, so a boss fight gets one: put your trinkets and your damage racial, if your race has one, on the same press. On the leveling build Rapid Killing has it back every three minutes, so press it on every hard pull.
Aimed Shot whenever the cooldown it shares with Multi-Shot is up. Your auto shots keep firing while you cast it, so there is no auto shot to wait for, and it outhits Multi-Shot.

Multi-Shot on cooldown at 18 and 19, while you are above a quarter of your mana. From 20 Aimed Shot takes the shared cooldown whenever it is up, so Multi-Shot is for packs and for moving. It is the worst damage for its mana you fire, so it is the first shot to go when the mana runs low.

Sniper Shot whenever it is ready and the shared cooldown is not. Your auto shots keep firing through its 4 second cast, so start it the moment it comes up. It is your hardest hit, on its own 15 second cooldown.

Serpent Sting when it has under 1.5 seconds left, and from 18 never while the shared cooldown is about to come back, unless you are under a quarter of your mana. Refreshing any earlier throws away a tick. Every tick carries 5% of your ranged attack power on top of its own damage, so from 18 it does more for its mana than Multi-Shot: keep it rolling for the whole fight.

Arcane Shot to fill a gap; from 18, only with the shared cooldown over a global away or under a quarter mana. It is instant and never holds an auto shot, and every hit carries 15% of your ranged attack power, so from 18 it does more for its mana than Multi-Shot: keep it going even when the mana runs low.
